Frequently Asked Questions

General

What does Prospergenics do?
Prospergenics is a community where members and coaches support each other to build real skills and create opportunities together. We train people in practical digital technology, including AI-assisted software development with tools like Claude Code and Cursor, alongside entrepreneurship, microcredit access, and cultural exchange, so participants can learn while earning income rather than just studying theory.
What does Prospergenics specialize in?
Prospergenics specializes in three practical programs: Digital Technology training (including AI and software development, such as Claude Code and Cursor coaching), Microcredit Access for equipment like laptops, phones, and agricultural tools, and Cultural Exchange between communities. Our active team is based in Kenya and the Netherlands, with a global, growing community.

Support

How can I contact Prospergenics for support?
You can reach Prospergenics through the Contact page on our website, where you will find our email address and a contact form to submit your inquiries. Community members can also connect through our newsletter and Community Forum.

Pricing

Is there a cost to join Prospergenics?
Joining the Prospergenics community is free -- we believe practical skills and support should be accessible to everyone. Some specialized offerings, such as one-on-one or team coaching in Claude Code and Cursor, are arranged directly through our Contact page based on your needs.

Features

What makes Prospergenics different from other tech education providers?
Unlike generic online courses, Prospergenics combines hands-on coaching, including production-level AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, with a real, active community spanning the Netherlands and Kenya. Members learn by building actual projects and businesses, supported by experienced coaches and mentors who use these same tools in their own daily work, rather than studying pre-recorded theory.
